text:
hana: quick flag from the crescent bring-up (q4b) on mixed CJK + RTL evals. observed quote/bracket reordering in detokenized output for short inline spans. repro below.
omar: paste minimal repro + model config pls
hana: model: crescent-v1 q4b-pack, tokenizer=hybrid-unified-2026. repro: zh + hebrew inline.
```
input: 

# actual unicode line: 我买了《新书》然后他说: "מה זה הדבר הזה?"
expected detok (fp16): 我买了《新书》然后他说: "מה זה הדבר הזה?"
q4b detok: 我买了》《新书然后他说: "מה זה הדבר הזה?“
# notes: corner brackets switched order around CJK seg, opening double-quote became closing curly in Hebrew context
```
lucas: that looks like a mirror/directionality bug in detok when alias tokens are used. did the packer add alias ids for corner brackets?
hana: yes packer introduces alias 9003 for LEFT_CORNER_BRACKET and maps back later.
omar: run tokenizer.verbose and compare token ids between fp16 and q4b for the sample. also check bidi resolution step in streaming vs batch.
triage-bot: triage/bisect/2987654322 queued; runner-3 assigned, ETA 20m
lucas: quick manual diff shows fp16 ids: [100, 3456, 7890, 1100] vs q4b ids: [100, 3456, 9003, 1100] where 9003 is alias. alias appears to be treated as mirrored during bidi reconcile which flips bracket order.
hana: metric snapshot: zh->he BLEU fp16 19.3, q4b 16.2 (delta -3.1). zh->en unaffected. link: https://redwood-internal/eval/298765-crescent-q4b
omar: provisional mitigation: map alias punctuation to canonical neutral codepoints before bidi reconciliation, or mark alias tokens as mirror-neutral in token metadata. please run small A/B: (A) disable packing, (B) neutralize alias metadata.
triage-bot: update: job started on runner-3
hana: also note this surfaces more with short inline quotes (single sentence) than long RTL paragraphs; likely bidi stack edge-case when embedding direction flips mid-line.
lucas: add unit tests covering CJK corner bracket + RTL embedded sentence + streaming/batch detok. if fix changes detok, add smoke to multilingual suite.
triage-bot: job complete. result: disabling packer recovers BLEU to 19.1 and restores bracket order. marking alias neutral in detok gives partial recovery. recommended: short-term tokenizer post-normalize; long-term: packer tag change.
hana: opening PR for post-normalize and adding tests. will coordinate perf checks.
